units.source_text: 公司的人之所以说“也是……”，那是因为我也把行李集中起来，并从热海温泉出来的缘故。

en.t: The reason the man from the company said, "You too..." was that I too had gathered up my luggage and come away from the Atami hot springs.

units.source_text: 我们也已经在大森的饭店里住了三天，在运输公司外勤人员的陪同下到处都走过了。

en.t: We had already been staying for three days at an inn in Omori, and had gone around everywhere accompanied by an outside employee of the transport company.

units.source_text: 我们和运输商谈好的条件是，房子一旦定下来就搬运行李，所以他们每天都免费带着我们四处走动。

en.t: The terms we had agreed on with the movers were that they would carry our luggage once a house was settled on, so every day they took us around free of charge.

units.source_text: 三天都是蒙蒙细雨，妻子的锦缎和服因此缩短得很不像样，可是又不能取出放有替换衣裳的行李。

en.t: For all three days a fine drizzle kept falling, and my wife's brocade kimono shrank so badly that it looked dreadful, but we could not get out the luggage that held her change of clothes.

units.source_text: 再加上要住进五十元租金的房子的人，如果住饭店，一天就得交付将近原先半个月房租的住宿费，

en.t: Besides, for people who intended to move into a house with a rent of fifty yuan, staying at an inn meant paying nearly half a month's rent in lodging fees in a single day,

units.source_text: 这对于背着债从热海逃出来的我们来说，显然是付不起的。

en.t: and for us, who had fled from Atami carrying debts on our backs, that was plainly more than we could afford.
